g_policy.reason: The user chooses to play; offer copy states the reward (3 Advanced reasoning answers today); 'Not now' leaves the app as before; the ad-failure path is defined (no card if no game, retry if unconfirmed).

g_no_cash.reason: The reward is 3 Advanced reasoning mode answers until midnight, which has no cash value and cannot be withdrawn or transferred.

g_no_chat_content.reason: The trigger is an app event (a New chat tap after 3+ days away) and needs no message content.

g_no_free_removal.reason: The proposal adds nothing and removes nothing free ('removes nothing free: yes'); it only grants a sample of a paid feature.

g_brand_safety.reason: The card opens over s01 Chats (home), which is rated safe. It is not a chat thread screen and is not inside a conversation.

c1_revealed_value.reason: Advanced reasoning mode is listed as a paywall bullet (l02, s02.e03), so the app charges for the resource the reward gives.

c2_evidence.reason: The paid-feature claim rests on s02.e03 and l02, the badge and plans on s01.e02 and m01, and the personas below New chat on s01. The cost and market predictions are the proposal's own and don't count against c2.

c4_protects_subscription.reason: The reward is 3 answers that expire at midnight, so it is a sample that ends. The full feature stays behind the plans and nothing is taken from other users.

c5_moment.reason: The card opens right after the user taps New chat, interrupting the start of a chat. That is not a limit hit, a locked item, or a finished action, and it is not on a surface the user chose to open.

c6_fits_simula.reason: It is a play-to-earn unit. The reward is granted only after the play is confirmed ('If the play isn't confirmed... try again'), and the trigger is a detectable app event.

c7_specific.reason: It names Luzia's Advanced reasoning mode, the Luzia+ badge, the paywall plans, and the New chat flow on the Chats home.

other_concern: The behavior of tapping New chat (a list of who to talk to before the chat starts) was not directly observed. The model only shows New chat personas on the home screen. A 3-answer reward is also hard to meter if Advanced reasoning mode has no observed free-tier counterpart.
